task: Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/stereo.wav already loaded (a 2-second stereo 44.1 kHz WAV). Convert the stereo track to mono and export the result to /home/user/Music/mono.wav as a mono 44100 Hz 16-bit PCM WAV file.
task_grounding:
Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/stereo.wav already loaded (a 2-second stereo 44.1 kHz WAV). The project therefore has one stereo track.

Convert the stereo track to a single mono track via Tracks > Mix > Mix Stereo Down to Mono. After this, the project should have exactly one mono track.

Then export the audio as a WAV file to /home/user/Music/mono_out.wav using File > Export > Export as WAV. Keep the default 'WAV (Microsoft) signed 16-bit PCM' settings. If a metadata dialog appears, click OK.
